title: Earthquake early warning alert
description: An earthquake early warning alert as it appears on a phone (variant phone: wireless emergency alert style, short text) or in an app (variant app: with estimated magnitude, expected shaking and the seconds of warning for the place). Early warning is a few seconds to tens of seconds before shaking; near the epicenter an alert can arrive after the shaking starts.

message.description: The alert text shown to the person
examples: Earthquake! Drop, Cover, Hold On. Protect yourself.

sentAt.description: Time the alert was sent (local, with seconds)

expectedMmi.description: Expected shaking at the place (Modified Mercalli, Roman numeral; app variant)

secondsWarning.description: Seconds of warning for the place before shaking is expected (0 if the alert is late)
